title: Notifications & Escalations
changes: Added company-scoped notification/escalation policy projection composed over existing Workforce global defaults and notification runtime.
Added runtime-capability validation for requested notification channels while retaining IN_APP fallback for HIGH/CRITICAL when available.
Allowed acknowledgement timing, delivery attempts, escalation depth and dedupe cooldown to tighten but never loosen Pass14 company defaults.
Kept HIGH/CRITICAL escalation paths mandatory while allowing lower urgencies to opt into stricter acknowledgement/escalation requirements.
Kept recipient identities, live delivery state, dispatch and escalation transitions outside generic Settings; escalation remains governed and authority-neutral.
Forward-ported Settings lineage from Manager Merge27 without overwriting Yjs injection, Workforce dataset repair, protected runtime hashes or other newer Manager files.
